items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Same part, Queenie, in Showboat with Paul Robeson... Mr. Hammerstein and Sir Alfred Butt and Jerome Kern said they wanted the real thing... Sir Alfred Butt, Oscar Hammerstein and Jerome Kern were in the audience, and they heard me.

ctx.x: You were vying for the same part?

Same part, Queenie, in Showboat with Paul Robeson. So I sang -- she sang first, and she was marvelous. And I had no sense about worrying, you know. I just went on out there and sang, because I always tried to be natural, you know, and I sang. So then I get a note saying -- no, I looked in -- yes, I get a note saying I had the part. And the newspaper came out and said why they chose me was because Mr. Hammerstein and Sir Alfred Butt and Jerome Kern said they wanted the real thing. Maizie Ailing was wonderful, but…
Do you remember what you sang?
